title: Email::keywords doc says 'HashMap<Id, bool> shape' but key type is String, not Id
description: email.rs line ~194: doc comment says 'Same HashMap<Id, bool> shape as mailbox_ids'. The actual field is HashMap<String, bool> not HashMap<Id, bool>. Keywords start with '$' which is not valid in a JMAP Id (RFC 8620 §1.2 allows only A-Za-z0-9). The 'shape' language refers to JSON structure but a reader scanning the doc for the Rust type gets the wrong type. Suggested fix: 'Same JSON object shape (string-keyed, bool values) as mailbox_ids, but keys are String not Id — keywords may contain \'$\' which is not valid in a JMAP Id.'
